documents.title: Listing of Equity Shares of Baheti Recycling Industries Ltd

analysis.summary: Baheti Recycling Industries Limited reported strong financial and operational performance for H1 FY27, driven by revenue and profit growth alongside capacity expansions. Management revised its FY28 revenue guidance upwards to over Rs 1,300 crores while maintaining its margin trajectory. The company is actively expanding its Aluminium Wire Rod division and modernising its manufacturing facilities to enhance operational efficiency. Additionally, the company received in-principle approval from NSE and BSE for its migration from the SME platform to the Main Board. Management reported strong financial performance for FY26 with revenue reaching approximately 725 crores and profit reaching 27 crores.

guidance.claim: The company revised its FY28 revenue guidance upwards from Rs 1,100 crores to Rs 1,300+ crores while maintaining its existing margin trajectory.
guidance.quote: Accordingly, we have revised our FY28 revenue guidance upwards from ₹1,100 crores to ₹1,300+ crores, while maintaining our existing margin trajectory.

guidance.claim: The company targets full capacity utilization by FY28.
guidance.quote: Our plan is to ramp up utilization, full capacity utilization by FY28.

guidance.claim: Phase 1 of the aluminum wire rod plant has an annual revenue potential of around 250 crores.
guidance.quote: We are targeting in Phase 1 around 12,500 metric ton per annum, with an annual revenue potential of 250-odd crores

guidance.claim: Phase 2 of the aluminum wire rod plant will increase capacity to 25,000 tons and add another 250 odd crores in revenue, totalling around 500 odd crores.
guidance.quote: In phase 2, it will increase to 25,000 tons. That, that means the revenue will also increase by another 250 odd crores. So, total revenue from this plant will be somewhere around 500 odd crores.

guidance.claim: Management is heading into FY27 with a minimum order book of 200 crores, excluding the aluminum wire rod plant.
guidance.quote: We are heading into FY27 with an order of Minimum 200 crores with us. And there are a lot of excitement development. This is excluding order book or the plant of aluminum wire rod.

guidance.claim: Management expects sustainable EBITDA margins in the business to range between 7% to 10%.
guidance.quote: See, the EBITDA margin in our industry is a sustainable EBITDA margin which we are working on. So anywhere between 7 to 10% is very it's quite sustainable EBITDA margin in our kind of industry

guidance.claim: The company expects to exceed a revenue milestone of ₹1,200 crore by FY28.
guidance.quote: We are confidently positioned to exceed a Revenue milestone of ₹1,200Cr by FY28

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that confidence in growth prospects is supported by increasing demand, capacity enhancements, and a growing presence across key industries.
demand_outlook.quote: Over the past few quarters, our confidence in the Company's growth prospects has strengthened, supported by increasing demand, capacity enhancements and a growing presence across key industries.

demand_outlook.claim: The upward revision in guidance is attributed to improved business visibility and opportunities across existing and upcoming product segments.
demand_outlook.quote: This upward revision is due to improved business visibility and the opportunities we see across our existing and upcoming product segments.

demand_outlook.claim: Global primary aluminum supply has been disrupted due to geopolitical tension in the Middle East, pushing customers towards reliable secondary sources.
demand_outlook.quote: Global primary aluminum supply has been disrupted, particularly from the geopolitical tension going on in the Middle East, and that is pushing customer everywhere towards reliable secondary sources.

demand_outlook.claim: The demand and government policy tailwinds are present, and global industry dynamics favor secondary recycling aluminum.
demand_outlook.quote: The demand is that the government policy tailwinds are there, the global industry dynamics are in favor of secondary recycling aluminium.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic scrap is currently 7-8% more expensive than imported scrap.
demand_outlook.quote: No, no not that much, to be very honest. We have not compared, but you can say 7-8% would be expensive.

demand_outlook.claim: Disruptions in the Middle East have tightened primary aluminium supply globally, creating real pressure on availability.
demand_outlook.quote: Disruptions in the Middle East have tightened primary aluminium supply globally, and the pressure on availability is real.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is expanding the Aluminium Wire Rod division capacity on existing owned land in two phases targeting a total capacity of 25,000 MT.
capex_expansion.quote: A key priority for us is the expansion of our Aluminium Wire Rod division, where we are expanding our capacity on our existing owned land in two phases. Over time, we intend to have a total wire-rod capacity of 25,000 MT, representing a revenue opportunity of approximately ₹500 crores annually.

capex_expansion.claim: The company incurred a capex of Rs 10 crores per furnace per paid for new machinery to strengthen manufacturing capabilities.
capex_expansion.quote: CAPEX of ₹10Cr. per furnace per paid incurred to strengthen our manufacturing capabilities.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is ready to commence 5 new electrical furnaces in FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: As part of this, we are now ready to commence 5 new electrical furnaces in FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is investing around 25 crores to build out the aluminum wire rod product in two phases on existing freehold land in Dahegam.
capex_expansion.quote: We are investing somewhere around 25-odd crores to build this out in two phases on our existing freehold land in Dahegam

capex_expansion.claim: Phase 2 of the aluminum wire rod project would require a maximum of 5 crores for putting up the furnace and associated equipment.
capex_expansion.quote: Phase 2 would be 5 crores maximum in putting up the furnace and all.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is investing ₹20–25 Crores in FY27 to build out its Aluminium Wire Rod division on existing freehold land.
capex_expansion.quote: On the capacity side, we are putting ₹20–25 Crores to work in FY27 to build out our Aluminium Wire Rod division on our existing freehold land.

capex_expansion.claim: Phase 1 of the Aluminium Wire Rod division targets 12,500 MT and expects to generate ₹200–250 Crores in annual revenue.
capex_expansion.quote: Phase 1 targets 12,500 MT, which we expect to generate between ₹200–250 Crores in annual revenue.

capex_expansion.claim: Scaling Phase 2 to 25,000 MT in forthcoming years brings the revenue potential to ₹500 Crores a year.
capex_expansion.quote: When we scale to 25,000 MT in Phase 2 in forthcoming years, the revenue potential from this division alone reaches ₹500 Crores a year.

capex_expansion.claim: Total smelting capacity is 38,000 MT, with five more electric furnaces lined up for FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: Alongside this, we have been replacing our older pit furnaces with more Electric Furnaces, taking our total smelting capacity to 38,000 MT, and five more furnaces are lined up for FY27.

margins_costs.claim: Revenue from operations grew by 67.69% YoY to Rs 528.47 crores, EBITDA increased by 99.48% to Rs 42.37 crores, and PAT grew by 105.83% to Rs 19.08 crores in H1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: Revenue from operations grew by 67.69% YoY to ₹528.47 crores, while EBITDA increased by 99.48% to ₹42.37 crores and PAT grew by 105.83% to ₹19.08 crores.

margins_costs.claim: Modern tilting rotary furnaces drive operational efficiency through optimum utilisation of power, labour, and fuel.
margins_costs.quote: These modern machines drive operational efficiency through optimum utilization of Power, Labour and Fuel.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin for H1 FY27 stood at 9.70% compared to 9.05% in H1 FY26.
The EBITDA margin of the aluminum wire rod division is expected to improve by 1 or 2% from the existing business.
margins_costs.quote: The EBITDA margin will improve by 1 or 2% from the existing business.

margins_costs.claim: The cost of production increased by 15% due to fuel prices.
margins_costs.quote: See, the cost of production has increased, no doubt about it, because of the fuel prices, the cost of production has increased by 15%.

margins_costs.claim: The captive solar plant will directly cut power costs on electric furnaces, with margin benefits starting from Q2.
margins_costs.quote: Our captive solar plant should be running by end of May 2026 and this directly cuts our power costs on the electric furnaces, and the margin benefit will start showing up from Q2 onwards.

orders_capacity.claim: With the addition of the new furnaces and solar plant, total installed capacity will stand at 38,000 tons annually.
orders_capacity.quote: With this addition, our total installed capacity will stand to 38,000 tons annually.

orders_capacity.claim: As of Q1 FY27, confirmed order book stands at over ₹175 Crores.
orders_capacity.quote: As we step into Q1 FY27, our confirmed order book already stands at over ₹175 Crores, a reflection of the steady demand for secondary aluminium domestically and the trust our clients continue to place in us.

capital_allocation.claim: The company is actively focused on reducing debt and improving key financial ratios.
capital_allocation.quote: Furthermore, company’s actively focused on Reducing the debt and improving the key financial ratio.

capital_allocation.claim: The company raised ₹7.48 Crores through a Preferential Allotment to keep working capital healthy.
capital_allocation.quote: We also raised ₹7.48 Crores through a Preferential Allotment to keep working capital healthy as volumes grow.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that if the market falls down vertically over 6 months or 1 year, a loss would be seen during that 6-month period.
risks_headwinds.quote: during that case when the market falls down vertically over 6 months or 1 year, then during that 6 months you will see a loss because in that case scenario no one can predict the vertical fall, or no one can judge that vertical fall.

management_commitments.claim: The company intends to achieve a total wire-rod capacity of 25,000 MT over time.
management_commitments.quote: Over time, we intend to have a total wire-rod capacity of 25,000 MT, representing a revenue opportunity of approximately ₹500 crores annually.

management_commitments.claim: Phase 1 of the Aluminium Wire Rod capacity is scheduled to be live by Q4FY27.
Mandatory EPI norms will be implemented at 5% in FY28 and 10% in FY29.
management_commitments.quote: The government is also pushing, significantly EPI norms are, will be mandatory from FY28- 5% and, in FY29, it will be 10%.

management_commitments.claim: The company is targeting full capacity utilization by FY28.
management_commitments.quote: Our plan is to ramp up utilization, full capacity utilization by FY28.

management_commitments.claim: Phase 1 of the aluminum wire rod project is expected to be commissioned by the end of October or early November.
management_commitments.quote: By the end of October, you can say early November.

management_commitments.claim: The captive solar plant is expected to be running by the end of May 2026.
management_commitments.quote: Our captive solar plant should be running by end of May 2026 and this directly cuts our power costs on the electric furnaces, and the margin benefit will start showing up from Q2 onwards.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
